corrections.was: the packet brief placed the call site 00944E0A inside 00944FD0 BSP_LuaBinding_GenerateObject
corrections.is: 00944E0A is inside BSP_LuaBinding_Spawn, body 00944680-00944FC0; GenerateObject's body is 00944FD0-0094544F
corrections.evidence: python tools/bsp.py ghidra proto 00944e0a --brief. 00944680 is leased to agent/cc-lua-core, so the site was not read and no claim here rests on it.

corrections.was: docs/LUA_BINDING_ENTITY.md: 0088B1B0 skips entries whose four flag bytes at +5C..+5E and piVar4[0x17] disagree
corrections.is: the four bytes are +5Ch (must be non-zero), +5Dh, +5Eh and +60h (must be zero); piVar4[0x17] is +5Ch itself and piVar4[0x18] is +60h
corrections.evidence: 0088B213 CMP byte ptr [EAX+0x5c],0 / JZ; 0088B21D +0x5d / JNZ; 0088B227 +0x60 / JNZ; 0088B231 +0x5e / JNZ

corrections.was: docs/LUA_BINDING_ENTITY.md: it walks the bucket lists at [[00E188A8]+19CCh]+1Ch+n
corrections.is: the list bases are at world+18h with stride 0Ch, indexed by kind+6; 1Ch is the head field of the base, the producer 00484540 lays a base out as {count, head, tail}
corrections.evidence: 00484540 stores count at [this], head at [this+4], tail at [this+8]; every one of the 174 registration sites adds an offset of the form 18h + n*0Ch to the parent node

corrections.was: docs/LUA_BINDING_ENTITY.md: the set of kind indices 0088B1B0 searches was not decoded past the jump table
corrections.is: fourteen kinds are searched: 00h, 09h, 12h, 13h, 14h, 15h, 16h, 3Bh, 3Eh, 3Fh, 40h, 41h, 44h, 47h; the negative kinds and 48h..5Ah fail the unsigned bound at 0088B1E0 and are never searched
corrections.evidence: the selector bytes at 0088B318 read with bsp.py ghidra bytes; 0088B1E0 CMP EBX,0x47 / JA is unsigned while EBX starts at 0xFFFFFFFA
